prompt: open the top drawer and put the bowl inside
scope: Use official middle-drawer initial state 3 for every path. Restore the identical two contact donors, eight seeds, two independent model loads, 60 preparation controls, checkpoint and 20 Hz native physics of drawer/stove_fingers.json. The only new policy goal is the benchmark task language for upper-drawer bowl placement. The policy sees two live RGB views, proprioception and the task instruction.
standalone: Before comparing preparations, run all eight seeds in each of two model loads from the standard warmed neutral state on the same layout. Record ever-in, in at the deadline, top-drawer contact and native top-open. An actual placement within 300 controls establishes standalone competence at the primary budget; a first placement by 600 only establishes extended-budget competence. If standalone fails, the endpoint comparisons remain diagnostic and do not establish a task-dependent preference.
paired: Use every physical donor and seed in both model loads. Rotate mode order and reverse it in load 2. Count total time from the end of middle-drawer opening, including preparation. All paths continue through 600 controls even if In becomes true. Compare at equal total time, and additionally after 240 and 540 active policy controls.
outcomes: Primary is native In at 300 total controls. Report 8, 15, and 30 s, first gripper contact with moving top drawer, first native top-open and first bowl-in. Also report ever-in, continuous in-region with no gripper-bowl contact over the final 20 controls, actual bowl/top-body contact at the deadline, and the middle drawer open at the deadline. Times to events are conditional on reaching them.
decision: Claim a reversal from the stove result on this layout only if the standalone primary gate passes and finger hold beats return in paired terminal placements in every donor by model-load cell at 15 s. The symmetric rule describes a return advantage. Report ties, disagreements and any changes at 30 s; contact or openness alone cannot decide placement. Two physical donors and 16 unique donor/seed pairs limit generalization.
